intuition: For each value in the first array, count its complement in the mutable second array.

brute_force.approach: Try every pair of elements when answering a target sum query.

optimal.approach: Maintain frequencies for the second array and scan the first array, looking up each complement.
optimal.space: O(n + distinct values in second array)

edge_cases: Duplicate values contribute once per occurrence.
Adding to an index updates both the array and its frequency count.
